f.title: Local contact person carries out local PV tasks, linked to the EEA QPPV
f.statement: The local contact person is linked to the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance at European level and is responsible for carrying out local pharmacovigilance tasks.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
f.legal_basis: Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, Art. 66 §2 (as revised)

rows.actor: Local contact person for pharmacovigilance (designated by the marketing authorisation or registration holder)
rows.quote:
The local contact person is linked to the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance at the

European level and is responsible for carrying out local tasks concerning pharmacovigilance.
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: added. 'is responsible for carrying out local tasks' defines the role's duty under revised Art. 66 §2 (the function replaces the former local person responsible for PV). Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Role description with no modal verb: "is linked to ... and is responsible for" states what the function is; Mandatory level is a judgement call. Quote clean.

f.title: Local contact person need not be registered, hold a diploma or prove PV experience
f.statement: The local contact person does not have to be registered on a list set up by the minister or his representative, nor meet diploma requirements or submit a certificate proving at least one year's experience in pharmacovigilance.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)

rows.quote:
The local contact person does not have to be registered on a list set up by the minister or his
representative. Nor does he/she have to meet the demands in terms of diplomas or submit a certificate

proving at least one year’s experience in pharmacovigilance.
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Permitted ('does not have to'). Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Quote clean and alone proves the statement; "does not have to" = Permitted.

f.title: Local contact person must be contactable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
f.statement: The local contact person for pharmacovigilance must be contactable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I), requirements under revised Art. 66 §2 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006
f.legal_basis: Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, Art. 66 §2 (as revised)

rows.actor: Local contact person for pharmacovigilance (designated by the marketing authorisation or registration holder)
rows.quote: He/she must be contactable 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I), requirements under revised Art. 66 §2 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006
rows.review_note: Review: legal_basis set to RD 14 Dec 2006 Art. 66 §2 (the circular cites it; the OCR renders '§2' as '82', which is kept out of the quote). Quote checked: no OCR noise (leading bullet 'e' excluded). Double-check: OCR source. Quote starts "He/she" and lacks its lead-in ("following the revised article 66 82 ... the local contact person must meet the following requirements"), so the actor is carried from the preceding sentence. Otherwise clean.

f.title: Local contact person must carry out pharmacovigilance activities in Belgium
f.statement: The local contact person for pharmacovigilance must carry out pharmacovigilance activities in Belgium.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I), requirements under revised Art. 66 §2 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006
f.legal_basis: Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, Art. 66 §2 (as revised)

rows.actor: Local contact person for pharmacovigilance (designated by the marketing authorisation or registration holder)
rows.quote: He/she must carry out activities in pharmacovigilance in Belgium
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I), requirements under revised Art. 66 §2 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006
rows.review_note: Review: legal_basis set to RD 14 Dec 2006 Art. 66 §2 (the circular cites it; the OCR renders '§2' as '82', which is kept out of the quote). Quote checked: no OCR noise (leading bullet 'e' excluded). Double-check: OCR source. Quote starts "He/she" and lacks its lead-in ("following the revised article 66 82 ... the local contact person must meet the following requirements"), so the actor is carried from the preceding sentence. "in Belgium" is the quote's own wording.

f.title: Local contact person must have adequate qualifications and language skills
f.statement: The local contact person must have adequate qualifications to carry out pharmacovigilance activities, in particular the language skills needed to receive correspondents in the national language they choose and to communicate with the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I), requirements under revised Art. 66 §2 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006
f.legal_basis: Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, Art. 66 §2 (as revised)

rows.actor: Local contact person for pharmacovigilance (designated by the marketing authorisation or registration holder)
rows.quote:
He/she must have adequate qualifications to carry out his/her activities in pharmacovigilance,
particularly the necessary language skills to be able to receive correspondents in the national language
they choose and to be able to communicate with the qualified person responsible for

pharmacovigilance.
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I), requirements under revised Art. 66 §2 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006
rows.review_note: Review: legal_basis set to RD 14 Dec 2006 Art. 66 §2 (the circular cites it; the OCR renders '§2' as '82', which is kept out of the quote). Quote checked: no OCR noise (leading bullet 'e' excluded). Double-check: OCR source. Quote starts "He/she" and lacks its lead-in ("following the revised article 66 82 ... the local contact person must meet the following requirements"), so the actor is carried from the preceding sentence. Otherwise clean.

f.title: Former local PV responsible persons must meet the new requirements if designated as local contact
f.statement: Persons currently approved as local persons responsible for pharmacovigilance (with a "P number") do not automatically assume the function of local contact person; they must meet the new requirements for local contact persons if they are designated as local contact person.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
f.applicability: Persons currently approved as local persons responsible for pharmacovigilance ("P number").

rows.quote:
We would draw your attention to the fact that the persons who are currently approved as local persons
responsible for pharmacovigilance (with a “P number”) do not automatically assume the function of local
contact person but they must meet the new demands for local contact persons as mentioned above in

case they are designated as local contact person.
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Quote clean and proves "must meet the new demands ... in case they are designated"; holder as actor is the party that designates.

f.title: Declare the designated local contact person to FAMHP using the Appendix 1 form
f.statement: Marketing authorisation or registration holders must submit to FAMHP a declaration giving the name and contact details of the designated local contact person and stating that this person meets the requirements and has the qualifications and means necessary to carry out the pharmacovigilance tasks; the Appendix 1 form is to be completed in full and an electronic (PDF) version sent by e-mail to the address given in the circular.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)

rows.quote:
Marketing authorisation or registration holders must submit to FAMHP a declaration indicating the name

and contact details of the designated local contact person and indicating that the local contact person
meets the above demands and has the qualifications and means necessary for carrying out his tasks in
matters of pharmacovigilance. Please complete in full the form in the appendix (Appendix 1) and send an
electronic version (PDF) of this form to the following e-mail address:
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote stops before the e-mail address; statement refers to 'the address given in the circular'. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Quote clean, stops before the e-mail address; "must submit" proves the duty, actor and declaration content.

f.title: EEA QPPV based in Belgium may also act as local contact person
f.statement: If the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance at European level carries out his/her activities in Belgium, he/she can combine that function with the function of local contact person, provided the requirements for the local contact person are met.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
f.applicability: EEA QPPV carrying out activities in Belgium.

rows.quote:
If the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance at the European level is carrying out his
activities in Belgium, he/she can combine the function of qualified person responsible for
pharmacovigilance with the function of local contact person, provided the requirements for the local
contact person are met.
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Permitted ('can combine'). Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Quote clean; "can combine ... provided the requirements ... are met" proves the permission and its condition.

f.title: Notify FAMHP via Appendix 1 when the EEA QPPV is designated as local contact person
f.statement: Where the EEA QPPV is designated as local contact person, the marketing authorisation or registration holder must advise FAMHP of this designation by means of the Appendix 1 form.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
f.applicability: EEA QPPV carrying out activities in Belgium designated as local contact person.

rows.quote:
In this case the marketing authorization or registration holder must advise
FAMHP that this person has been designated as the local contact person by means of the form in the
appendix (Appendix 1)
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Quote opens "In this case": the condition (EEA QPPV designated as local contact) comes from the preceding sentence (0007).

f.title: Re-declare existing registered local PV persons who now qualify as local contact persons
f.statement: For currently designated local persons responsible for pharmacovigilance already registered with FAMHP by declaration who now meet the new requirements to act as local contact persons, the marketing authorisation or registration holder is asked by FAMHP to submit a new declaration using the Appendix 1 form, confirming the designation of this person as local contact person.
f.clause: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
f.applicability: Local persons responsible for pharmacovigilance already registered with FAMHP by declaration who meet the new requirements.

rows.quote:
Concerning the currently designated local persons responsible for pharmacovigilance who have already
been registered with FAMHP by means of a declaration and who now meet the new above-mentioned
requirements to be able to act as local contact persons, we would also ask the marketing authorisation or
registration holder to submit a new declaration to FAMHP by means of the form in the appendix
(Appendix 1), thus confirming the designation of this person as local contact person.
rows.location: 1. Notification of the local contact person for pharmacovigilance (Appendix I)
rows.review_note: Review: level Recommended -> Mandatory. 'We would also ask' is FAMHP's instruction on how to meet the duty in 0006 ('must submit ... a declaration'): a former local responsible person does not automatically become local contact person (0005), so the holder's designation must be declared; the transitional rule (0014) asks all holders to send the Appendix 1 form within three months. Statement keeps the source's 'ask' wording. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Level is a judgement call: the wording is "we would also ask", not "must". Mandatory kept because the underlying declaration duty is stated with "must" in 0006 and a P-number person does not automatically become local contact person (0005); the statement keeps the source's "is asked" wording. Not 90 because the modal force is inferred, not quoted.

f.title: Notify FAMHP as soon as possible of any change in pharmacovigilance system data (Appendix II)
f.statement: To keep FAMHP's pharmacovigilance-system data correct and up to date, every marketing authorisation or registration holder is required to advise FAMHP as soon as possible of any change in the data; Appendix II is to be completed in full and an electronic (PDF) version sent by e-mail to the address given in the circular.
f.clause: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II)

rows.deadline: As soon as possible after any change in the data
rows.quote:
In order to have correct and up-to-date data about the pharmacovigilance system, every marketing

authorisation or registration holder is required to advise FAMHP as soon as possible about any changes in

the data. Please complete in full the appendix (Appendix II) and send an electronic version (PDF) of this

table to the following e-mail address:
rows.location: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II)
rows.review_note: Review: no change ('is required to' = Mandatory). Quote stops before the e-mail address. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Quote clean; "is required to advise FAMHP as soon as possible" proves level, actor and timing.

f.title: Provide holder, local contact person and EEA QPPV contact data
f.statement: The marketing authorisation or registration holder must fill in: its name, address and website; the family name, first name, professional address, telephone number, mobile phone number, 24/7 duty number, fax and e-mail address of the local contact person; and the same details for the person responsible for pharmacovigilance at European level (EEA QPPV).
f.clause: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II), items 1-3

rows.location: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II), items 1-3
data_elements: local contact person contact details incl. 24/7 duty number
EEA QPPV contact details incl. 24/7 duty number
rows.review_note: Review: no change. The OCR dropped the item number '1.' before 'name, address and website'; the quote is verbatim and carries no noise characters. Data elements kept; no phone numbers or addresses copied. Double-check: OCR source. List content (Appendix II items 1-3); OCR dropped the item number "1."; quote otherwise clean.

f.title: Provide PSMF location, local PV subcontractors and safety database host details
f.statement: The holder must also fill in: where appropriate, the address where the (pharmacovigilance system) Master File is located; where appropriate, the names, addresses, telephone and mobile numbers, e-mail addresses and websites of firms subcontracted for pharmacovigilance activities at local level, with the type of activity subcontracted; and the name, address (server) and telephone number of the company where the relevant electronic data on all suspected undesirable effects that occurred in the European Community or in a third country are collected and accessible.
f.clause: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II), items 4-6
f.processes: Local PV interfaces; PSMF management; Partner & vendor oversight

rows.quote:
if appropriate, address where the Master File is located ;

f.title: Also send the Appendix 1 form for each change to local contact person data
f.statement: For each change relating to the data about the local contact person, the Appendix 1 form mentioned in point 1 should also be sent by e-mail, in addition to the Appendix II table.
f.clause: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II)

rows.quote:
For each change relating to the data about the local contact person, apart from the table mentioned
above, the form mentioned in point 1 should also be sent by e-mail to:
rows.location: 2. Notification of additional data about pharmacovigilance (Appendix II)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Recommended kept ('should also be sent'). Quote stops before the e-mail address. Double-check: OCR source. Quote clean; "should also be sent" = Recommended; stops before the e-mail address.

f.title: Provide the required PV information to FAMHP within three months of the circular
f.statement: All marketing authorisation or registration holders are requested to provide FAMHP with the required pharmacovigilance information, by means of the Appendix 1 form and the Appendix II table, within three months following publication of the circular.

rows.deadline: Within three months following publication of the circular
rows.quote:
All marketing authorisation or registration holders are requested to advise FAMHP, within three months
following publication of this circular, by means of the form in the appendix (Appendix 1) and the table in
the appendix (Appendix II), the required information about pharmacovigilance.
rows.review_note: Review: level Mandatory confirmed: 'are requested to advise FAMHP, within three months' is the circular's transitional instruction with a fixed deadline, implementing the declaration and data-change duties stated with 'must'/'is required to' (0006, 0010). Deadline exact: within three months following publication of the circular (circular dated 15 June 2013 per OCR header). Section heading OCR-garbled ('3. Tr:'); location kept as 'Transitional provisions'. Double-check: OCR source. Level is a judgement call: "are requested to advise FAMHP, within three months" carries no "must"; Mandatory kept as the transitional implementation of the 0006/0010 duties. Section heading OCR-garbled ("3. Tr:"); circular date read from a garbled header ("SERA 15 JUNI 2013"). Transitional deadline long expired.

deadline_rule.applies_to: One-time notification of the local contact person and current PV information (Appendices I and II)

f.title: Title V pharmacovigilance provisions do not apply to homeopathic medicinal products (one article excepted)
f.statement: Under Article 42 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, the provisions of Title V of Part 1 do not apply to homeopathic medicinal products as meant in Article 38, with the exception of one article that the footnote names (OCR reads "article 68 8 2"; see exceptions).
f.legal_basis: Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, Arts 42 and 38
f.applicability: Homeopathic medicinal products as meant in Article 38 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006.
f.exceptions: The footnote keeps one article of Title V applicable; the OCR text reads "article 68 8 2", most likely Art. 68 §2. Verify against the original.

rows.quote:
Pursuant to Article 42 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006 concerning medicinal products for human and
veterinary use, the provisions of Title V of Part 1 do not apply, with exception to article 68 8 2, to homeopathic
medicinal products as meant in Article 38.
rows.review_note: Review: added (missed scope exclusion in the footnote, parallel to 0015). Quote cut before the OCR-garbled 'with exception to article 68 8 2'; the exception is given in exceptions as stated by the source but outside the quote. Level Permitted: holders are relieved of Title V duties for these products. Double-check: confirm the excepted article. Double-check: OCR source. Quote extended to the whole footnote sentence: the reviewed quote stopped at "do not apply" and did not prove "to homeopathic medicinal products as meant in Article 38" or the exception. The exception now sits in the quote but is OCR-garbled ("article 68 8 2", most likely Art. 68 §2 by analogy with "66 82" = 66 §2 elsewhere): verify against the original. Scope exclusion with a nominal Permitted level, footnote content.

f.title: Title V pharmacovigilance provisions apply to traditional herbal medicinal products
f.statement: Under Article 49 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006, the provisions of Title V of Part 1 apply to traditional herbal medicinal products.

rows.quote:
Pursuant to Article 49 of the Royal Decree of 14 December 2006 concerning medicinal products for human and
veterinary use, the provisions of Title V of Part 1 apply to traditional herbal medicinal products.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Footnote scope statement ("apply"), no modal verb; Mandatory level is nominal. Quote clean.

f.title: Centrally authorised products: follow Articles 21 and 22 of Regulation 1235/2010
f.statement: For authorisations granted under the centralised procedure, holders need to act in accordance with the provisions of Articles 21 and 22 of Regulation 1235/2010.
f.applicability: Authorisations granted under the centralised procedure.

rows.quote:
For authorisations granted according to the centralised procedure you need to handle in accordance with the provisions
of Articles 21 and 22 of regulation 1235/2010.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Quote checked: no OCR noise. Double-check: OCR source. Footnote cross-reference to Regulation 1235/2010 Arts 21-22 with no duty of its own; "you need to" read as Mandatory; actor taken from the circular's addressees.

dates.title: FAMHP Circular 600: MAHs and registration holders send local contact person and PV information
dates.scope: Holders of a marketing authorisation or registration for medicines for human use in Belgium (Appendix I form and Appendix II table)
dates.quote: All marketing authorisation or registration holders are requested to advise FAMHP, within three months following publication of this circular
dates.timing_note: Circular dated 2013-06-15 + 3 months = 2013-09-15. The base is the date on the letter ('15 JUNI 2013', OCR text); the circular's actual publication date is not stated separately, so the letter date is assumed to be the publication date.
